title: Nutanix Recognized as a Challenger in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Container Management
summary: NKP is designed to manage Kubernetes®, virtual machines, and stateful AI workloads under a single operational model across Nutanix infrastructure, public clouds, bare metal, or air-gapped environments.
body_markdown:
Nutanix has followed our[breakout year for Container Management](https://www.nutanix.com/blog/breakout-year-for-nutanix-container-management) with another year of recognition as a Challenger in this year’s Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Container Management. We believe this recognition highlights the evolution of our container strategy and the strength of the Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) solution.


[Download the full report today](https://www.nutanix.com/go/gartner-mq-2026-container-management)


## Meeting the Demands of GenAI and Sovereignty at Hybrid Scale


The container landscape is rapidly evolving alongside major industry shifts, including the explosion of GenAI inference, strict digital sovereignty objectives, and the imperative for cross-cloud control. Modern platform engineering requires managing Kubernetes®, virtual machines, and stateful AI workloads under a single, cohesive operational model.


NKP was designed specifically to support these enterprise demands, enabling consistent lifecycle management whether running on Nutanix infrastructure, public clouds, bare metal, or disconnected/air-gapped environments.


## Standalone Flexibility, Full Stack Strength


Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) gives organizations the choice to deploy as a standalone solution or fully integrate with the broader Nutanix Cloud Infrastructure (NCI) stack. Operating independently, NKP brings centralized fleet management, automated lifecycle operations, and consistent security controls across public clouds, bare-metal servers, and air-gapped environments. When combined with the full Nutanix stack, it bridges legacy virtual machines and modern cloud-native architectures through native hypervisor integration, enterprise storage data services, and unified management, helping to avoid infrastructure silos for both IT operators and application teams.


## Why Enterprises Choose NKP


- **Standalone Deployment Flexibility** : Functions as a standalone enterprise Kubernetes management platform independently of the broader Nutanix stack. Provides centralized control, security, and lifecycle operations across public clouds, bare-metal, and air-gapped footprints with strict isolation available between clusters and tenants.
- **Unified Infrastructure Stack** : Enterprises can consolidate virtual machines and container management on NCI, bridging legacy application requirements with modern cloud-native architectures while helping to avoid operational silos.
- **Enterprise Data Services for Stateful Workloads** : Helps protect persistent container data by leveraging native storage capabilities for structured and unstructured data, offering production-grade snapshots, replication, and disaster recovery for mission-critical workloads.
- **Support for Zero-Trust Security & AI-Assisted Operations** : Simplifies governance with integrated zero-trust networking alongside an LLM-powered assistant that provides real-time cluster health insights and operational recommendations.
- **Built for AI Workloads** : Supports GPU-enabled deployments and integrates natively with leading AI frameworks, including KServe, Kubeflow, MLflow, and PyTorch.


## Simplify Your Kubernetes Operations Today


To help organizations accelerate container platform modernization, an NKP starter tier is included with most Nutanix Cloud Infrastructure (NCI) subscriptions. Existing NCI customers can immediately begin deploying and managing Kubernetes clusters within their familiar operational framework.


Don’t have NCI?
